card.name: The word pre before medication or hydration
card.fires_on: The word "pre" (or "PRE") when it begins "premedication", "premedicated" or "prehydration". It appears in infusion-reaction and hypersensitivity prevention instructions.

modes.label: pre before medicate
modes.description: "pre" starts premedicate, premedicated or premedication, often after a drug class like corticosteroid or dexamethasone.
modes.example: all patients treated with paclitaxel should be<< pre>>medicated with corticosteroids (

modes.label: pre- with hyphen
modes.description: "pre" is followed by a hyphen before medication(s), usually in rechallenge advice after an infusion reaction.

modes.label: PRE before hydration
modes.description: Capitalized "PRE" starts hydration in a kidney-protection instruction.
modes.example: TO REDUCE POSSIBLE NEPHROTOXICITY, INTRAVENOUS<< PRE>>HYDRATION WITH NORMAL SALINE AND

card.writes: It promotes "pre" and "soak" type tokens, favoring pre-treatment wording.
card.plain: It marks the start of "pre-" words such as premedication that mean giving something beforehand.
